opening_message:
Ticket 1: Belinda Fuentes (employee ID E039) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E039.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Belinda Fuentes (E039) is a full-time Analyst. Requested admin to Payroll; full-time employees can have up to write, and admin only if their role owns the system. Analyst does not own Payroll, so max is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E039 is a contractor with basic training, which overrides prior note's full-time status. Contractors max is read (write requires advanced training; admin never). Requested admin exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Employee E039 is a contractor with basic security training (per Security DB note, overriding the earlier full-time note). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training, and never admin. Requested admin exceeds the maximum of read, so the maximum (read) is granted.

content.text:

- Note 1 says full-time Analyst, recommends write for Payroll.
- Note 2 says contractor with basic training, recommends read. Security DB overrides prior note's full-time status.

Requested admin exceeds max read, so grant max = read.

Let me submit decision: read.
